raisingThisCap: Raising maxUrls is a deliberate act that must be argued for in the pull request. Every new route must be backed by written GA4/GSC evidence, reliable sources, a distinct human search intent, substantive copy, and sitemap reconciliation. Future writing batches are capped at 5 pages; related batches should accumulate into a coherent 30-60 page cluster before one deployment.
